H3.statement: frozen metric R squared on kind shares at least 0.5

adoption.rule: kind-adjusted stability >= 0.5 with 95 percent interval above 0.3, and its R squared on kind shares below 0.2

verdict.protocol: H1 fails: the target is reliable, so the failed verdict is read as evidence against the metric

post_review_note: Fields finite_share, interval_defined, interval_valid_as_confidence_interval and interval_note, and the verdict's result and interval flags, were added after the review (2026-11-17); every pre-registered number was recomputed with the same seeds and is unchanged.
